svg.title: More languages than English — SoftTrack web design mockup (#315)
svg.desc: The interface was moved to i18next with a check that fails on text left in a component, and English is the only language there is. A person chooses a language under their profile, which follows the browser until they do; languages load when needed; right-to-left layout is tested on its own; emails are written in the recipient’s language; and what people write is never translated.

g.text: Settings → Profile → Language, signed in as Amina
The language SoftTrack speaks to you. What people write is never translated.
Follows your browser until you choose. This SoftTrack’s default is English.

svg.text: Errors from the API, by their code
Languages are loaded when they are needed, so the first page does
not carry them all. No language per team.
Done when a person can choose a language that follows the browser until they do, with an instance default; languages are loaded when needed; right-to-left layout works for the
sidebar, the board, directional icons and the editor; API errors are translated in the browser by their code; emails are written in the recipient’s language; a contributor has a guide
and a check for missing keys; and titles, comments and names are never translated.
